tickets.text: Trigger waits for a pullback into structure_shift_ref / pvp_vah first. In my position system the break above resistance is the entry and strength is the signal (C26); a value pullback is not a precondition I use. My entry: trade_above:bar_high (D), a buy stop 1 tick over the prior-day high, trailed each session until taken (C27).
horizon_sessions 10 is short for a position-system case (more than two weeks, C22), and the exit I use is a close under the support line max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d), not ma_20.

Position system: new high above resistance (D 1.4% above the last swing high, 0.2% under 20-day high), W and D HH/HL 9>21, but TIF INTERRUPTED does not confirm (C28). Wait for elder_pattern back to SUSTAINED or ACCELERATION, then the buy stop.

Position system: break right at the high (D 0.0% above the last swing high, HH/HL) but W swing LH/LL; under C21 (house rule, not the author's) wait for the weekly to print a higher high (0.2% under 20-wk high), then the buy stop.

On my test this is a new high above resistance, W and D HH/HL, TIF ACCELERATION: the position-system signal is present now (C26, C28); waiting for value is not my method. My entry: trade_above:bar_high (D), buy stop 1 tick over the prior-day high (C27).

In my position system extension (D 21.6% above the last swing high) is not a fault and TIF SUSTAINED confirms (C26, C28); the pullback precondition is not my rule. My entry: trade_above:bar_high (D), buy stop 1 tick over the prior-day high (C27).

horizon_sessions 10 is short for a position-system case (more than two weeks, C22); I hold until a close under the support line max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d) or elder_pattern rolling to INTERRUPTED (C29).
Position system: fresh break (D 0.9% above the last swing high, HH/HL) but TIF INTERRUPTED does not confirm (C28). Wait for elder_pattern back to SUSTAINED/ACCELERATION, then the buy stop.
